# Abcdef

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-abcdef)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-abcdef)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-abcdef)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-abcdef)

Abcdef is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-abcdef codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `abcdef` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { abcdef } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-abcdef';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, abcdef],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `abcdef` | `Extension` |
| `abcdefMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#0a0e14` |
| Active line | `#161d27` |
| Selection | `#1e2d41` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.54:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#efbb24` | bold | 10.87:1 | 9.53:1 | 7.83:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#efbb24` | bold | 10.87:1 | 9.53:1 | 7.83:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#ff9cac` | - | 9.77:1 | 8.56:1 | 7.04:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#d0d6e0` | - | 13.24:1 | 11.60:1 | 9.54:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#7799ff` | - | 7.17:1 | 6.28:1 | 5.17:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#ffee99` | - | 16.52:1 | 14.48:1 | 11.91:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#ffee99` | - | 16.52:1 | 14.48:1 | 11.91:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#abcdef` | - | 11.71:1 | 10.26:1 | 8.43:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#ffcc44` | - | 12.87:1 | 11.28:1 | 9.27:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#abcdef` | italic | 11.71:1 | 10.26:1 | 8.43:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#78a0d3` | - | 7.15:1 | 6.27:1 | 5.15:1 |
| String | `string` | `#7aecb3` | - | 13.33:1 | 11.68:1 | 9.61:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#6acdbe` | - | 10.21:1 | 8.95:1 | 7.36:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#c792ea` | - | 8.04:1 | 7.04:1 | 5.79:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#c792ea` | - | 8.04:1 | 7.04:1 | 5.79:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#7799ff` | - | 7.17:1 | 6.28:1 | 5.17:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#919498` | italic | 6.35:1 | 5.56:1 | 4.57:1 |
| Meta | `meta` | `#78a0d3` | - | 7.15:1 | 6.27:1 | 5.15:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#e0edff` | background, active line, selection | 11.76:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#d8e1f0` | gutter | 11.03:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#4fc1ff` | background, active line | 8.40:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#abcdef` | background | 11.71:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #abcdef` | background, active line | 10.26:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#38465b63, 3px solid #99c2ff` | background (fill or outline) | 10.61:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#1e2d41` | active line | 1.22:1 | Pass |
